notes.text: The page begins mid-proof. The manuscript discusses empty E1 and E2, invokes an excluded identity of two binary decompositions, and concludes unique determination of Sigma1+ and Sigma2+. Written intersection, comparison signs and indices were transcribed; the proof was not independently checked.

Two copies of an inclusion chain have arrows pointing from E1 and E2 toward their neighboring Sigmas. A single three-mark stroke precedes the lower chain. NB records two amalgam formulas, with E2 in the first amalgam subscript and E1 in the second. Earlier marks survive beneath the second left index and right Sigma.

The diagonal note discusses equalities among four signed Sigma sets, writes “qui équivaut à” before E_1=Sigma_12 and “et entraîne” before E_2=empty set, and then “On ne veut pas exclure ce cas”. The parenthesis before the first equality remains bien pas|non pas from its tall initial and compressed continuation. The overmark on the later Sigma is a visible left arrow. The ending n’exige pas is adopted after comparison with R1’s exigeons pas. Cancellation of sont and the crowded abbreviated qualification remain uncertain. These are reading decisions; the mathematical equivalence was not independently proved.

The lower paragraph proposes studying finite indexed families of pairwise non-parallel binary decompositions of X. The written adjective indicellés|indiciellés is retained. The live family glyph is Pi|pi, with Pi first from the horizontal roof and straight legs. Cancelled mathematical drafts remain included, including an unfinished opening set brace. The last word has initial fl and two p descenders; floppées|floppés preserves the faint ending.

The faint lower-left 26 is recorded as archive numbering. No title, date, authorial page number or total page count is visible on this sheet. The page carries no explicit proof-check request. The three readers excluded the accidental folder-wide notes footer from their evidence.

Mathematical reading cues were restricted to repeated local shapes: E subscripts, 12 on one lower level, 1 and 2 indices, crossed-oval empty set, and the repeated hooked arrows.
